# My Gold Melting

> My Gold Melting (https://gold-melting.evostackr.in/) is an offline-first, precision calculation suite designed for goldsmiths, jewellers, bullion assayers, and artisans. Developed by Ujwal Anand at Evostackr, the software computes multi-sample gold and silver melting purity, required additions of Palo (alloy) or pure fine gold to reach a target touch, and comprehensive jewellery costing with ten casting loss and expense factors.

## Core Capabilities

- **Gold & Silver Melting Control**: Compute weighted average touch across multiple gold/silver batches simultaneously. Calculate exact grams of Palo (alloy) or Fine Gold required to reach an exact target touch percentage.
- **Jewellery Cost Control**: Calculate final fine gold requirements and jewellery costing percentages factoring in gross gold weight, American Diamond (AD) stone deductions, and ten granular casting expenses.
- **Casting Expenses & Loss Calculation**: Precision sub-calculators for Alloy Loss, Casting Loss, Failing Loss, Sitting Loss, Polishing Loss, Stone Bill Loss, Gillet Loss, Rhodium Loss, Lathiya Pech Loss, and Extra Expenses.
- **Offline-First & Zero Telemetry**: Operates 100% locally in browser memory and IndexedDB. Zero data collection, zero tracking, zero remote transmission of financial or calculation data.
- **Trilingual Localization**: Full user interface support for English, Hindi (हिंदी), and Bengali (বাংলা).

## Key Definitions & Terminology

- **Touch (Touche / टंच)**: The purity percentage of precious metal (e.g., 91.6 touch = 22 Karat gold, 75.0 touch = 18 Karat gold, 99.9 touch = 24 Karat fine gold).
- **Palo (alloy / पालो)**: Base alloy metal (typically copper, silver, or zinc) added to higher-purity melted gold to lower its purity down to the desired target touch.
- **Fine Gold (फाइन गोल्ड)**: Pure 100% (or 99.9%) gold content contained in a given alloy or ornament.
- **Jewellery Costing**: The net fine gold equivalent percentage charging rate for custom ornament fabrication after compensating for stones and manufacturing losses.

- [Jewellery Costing Calculator Guide](https://gold-melting.evostackr.in/jewellery-costing-calculator): In-depth formulas for jewelry costing, fine gold calculation, and 10 casting loss factors.
